items.title: Philippine lifestyle press covers Gucci Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera preview held in Manila
items.summary: Philippine outlet Tribune covers Gucci's Fall/Winter 2026 'Primavera' collection, previewed in Manila on July 31 with local celebrities including Marian Rivera and Kyle Echarri styled in pieces such as the updated Bamboo 1947 bag, Horsebit Ristretto bag and Boulevard sneakers. Descriptive style feature framed around 'a sophisticated vocabulary' of modern luxury; activation-adjacent coverage tied to a brand-hosted event rather than independent critique.

items.title: BERNAMA regional headline roundup (Aug 8) situates luxury retail context across Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam
items.summary: Daily ASEAN cross-market headline digest from Malaysia's national wire, used here as corroborating evidence that no major standalone Gucci story broke across the five largest SEA news markets on this date -- consistent with this pool's broader finding that SEA-specific Gucci news volume is thin this week outside brand-hosted activation coverage. Included as a low-weight context marker rather than a substantive Gucci item.

items.source: Kering Q2 2026 results, APAC-ex-Japan detail (trade press synthesis)
items.title: Kering Q2 2026 earnings call: Gucci organic sales decline narrows to -2%, APAC ex-Japan still broadly flat to down
items.summary: Kering's Q2 2026 earnings call transcript shows Gucci's organic revenue decline narrowing to 2% (from -8% in Q1), driven by leather goods returning to growth on the Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches, beating analyst expectations of a 4.7% decline. Asia-Pacific excluding Japan -- the region containing Southeast Asia -- was characterized as broadly flat to down roughly 1% in the quarter, lagging the North American recovery. Retained past the strict freshness window as the most recent hard financial data point bearing directly on SEA regional performance; no more current APAC breakout has surfaced this week.

items.title: Hanoi counterfeit sellers shrug off Vietnam crackdown and US scrutiny despite raids targeting Gucci, Rolex, Prada fakes
items.summary: Malay Mail reports Hanoi's Ninh Hiep wholesale market -- named among the world's 'notorious markets' for counterfeiting by the USTR -- continues openly selling counterfeit goods bearing Gucci and other luxury logos despite raids, as Vietnam faces potential US tariff action over its status as a top counterfeiting hub. Critical-angle structural story on brand-protection failure in a key SEA growth market; kept as background despite age because it remains the most substantive counterfeit-enforcement narrative found this cycle and no fresher equivalent surfaced in searches run today.

items.title: PurseForum Gucci subforum keeps up daily thread activity on La Famiglia pieces, includes SEA-market pricing questions
items.summary: The PurseForum Gucci community subforum continues active daily posting into mid-August, with threads comparing regional pricing (including Singapore/Bangkok boutique quotes versus US/EU) and 'will you be buying' sentiment checks on the current Demna-era lineup. Consistent organic community pulse; captured as today's freshest snapshot of this recurring source, distinct from the subforum-level entry already logged yesterday (2026-08-11) to avoid an exact-URL duplicate while reflecting continued volume.

items.title: TikTok 'Gucci store in Philippines' discovery tag shows mixed haul/try-on and price-shock reaction content
items.summary: Aggregated TikTok discovery-tag content under 'Gucci store in Philippines' features a mix of boutique haul and try-on videos alongside price-shock reaction clips comparing Manila boutique tags to resale/outlet prices; consistent with prior observation that regional SEA consumer social content skews toward aspirational browsing with a recurring undercurrent of price commentary. No single dated post could be isolated for a precise published_at or engagement count from the aggregation page; treated as ambient, magnitude-damped SNS sentiment per policy rather than itemized individual posts.
